newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Volker Stevin sees higher 1997 profit.
newsitem.headline: Volker Stevin sees higher 1997 profit.

text.p: Construction firm Volker Stevin NV said on Friday it expected its 1997 profits to exceed those of 1996.
Earlier Volker Stevin reported a net profit of 73 million guilders in 1996 versus 58 million guilders in 1995.

"In view of market developments, the healthy order book at the end of 1996 and its balanced spread over the different sectors, we expect that the profit for 1997 will be higher than in 1996," the company said in a statement.
Volker Stevin said its forecast did not take into account the recent acquisition of railway construction activities from Dutch state rail company Nederlandse Spoorwegen.
